thread_text:
lina: Quick sync: gated bring-up for comet-q1 (PTQ int8). Golden-toolcall corpus shows parse success drop: fp16 99.97% -> int8 99.10%. Not catastrophic but measurable.

sam: failing emits cluster on control bytes + long embedded arrays in kv_prefix. Example emitted: {"tool":"append","args":["meta","\u0007\u0000\u001b"]} which our parser rejects.

noah: proposal: implement rescue heuristics behind a flag rather than global sanitizer. Rescue tries: 1) escape nonprintables in string tokens 2) envelope-wrap if truncation suspected. Mark rescues with telemetry.

lina: good. Acceptance criteria: run 50k mirror replay; compute parse_fails_before, parse_fails_after, rescues, induced_diffs. Reject if induced_diffs > 0.05%.

sam: prototype pseudocode: if parse(emitted) ok -> success else try escape_nonprintables -> parse -> success else try_envelope -> parse -> success else fail. Emit counters for rescued_escape and rescued_envelope.

triage-bot: ticket ML-7893 created and linked to canary dashboard.

noah: also add a delta-hash (tool+args) before/after rescue so we can list changed items for manual review. If rescue changes arg bytes, surface to solutions.

lina: plan: land PR behind flag `rescue_parse_nonprintable`, run mirror job (50k), collect CSV summary. If parse_fails drop by >=80% and induced_diffs <0.02% promote to canary-only default-on.

sam: replay job queued: https://replay.internal/jobs/2245. Will post summary when finished.

ops-bot: deploy: comet-q1-int8-gate deployed to mirror nodes at 12:42; replay queued.

lina: note for follow-up: add telemetry counters 'rescue_applied' and 'rescue_changed_bytes' and a dashboard tile in canary view.

noah: reminder: do not bump retry_budget; hiding failures with retries makes experiment useless. Keep retries same for metric integrity.

lina: thanks everyone. Reconvene here after replay completes to decide rollout.
